messages:
clare-h: Heads up — after last night's RBAC migration we started seeing a sharp spike in SCIM deprovision retries for a few tenants and a concurrent gap in audit events for service_account.role changes :eyes:

clare-h: Symptoms: SCIM queue shows repeated deprov attempts, users can't complete SSO, and lookup in audit-db shows missing events for the same time window. Noticed saml validation failures in auth-proxy logs.

clare-h: Sample from auth-proxy logs:
```
WARN  svc-provisioner: scim: deprov retry tenant=acme svc_acc=sa-analytics cause="assertion validation failed"
ERROR idp-validate: saml: artifact binding mismatch expected="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" got="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-Artifact"
audit: missing event id=0x7fa23 for tenant=acme action=service_account.update
```

raj-p: :thinking_face: Two quick hypotheses: (A) IdP metadata changed binding to Artifact and our SP still expects POST, or (B) KMS envelope key rotated and left stale wrapping key in token-store causing our signature verifier to accept a token but fail artifact resolution.

raj-p: Quick checks you can run:
```
# check SP metadata the proxy is serving
curl -s https://auth-proxy.internal/.well-known/saml-metadata | grep -i Binding
# check token-wrap alias in redis
kubectl exec -n infra deploy/provisioner -- redis-cli HGET token:wrap-key current_alias
```

kevin-m: I pulled the tenant metadata from Okta for that customer — their metadata advertises HTTP-Artifact only. We used to accept both; the SP config was tightened in the RBAC rollout to only accept POST. That would explain immediate assertion failures -> SCIM treating auth as a removal -> deprovs.

david-l: Also looked at the audit shipper logs around the rotation window. Shipper restarted mid-rotation, looks like a small window where events weren't flushed to audit-db. Grep output:
```
grep "service_account.update" -n /var/log/audit-shipper/shipper.log | tail -n 5
# found truncation and a SIGTERM at 1694449812
```

clare-h: Okay, so two concurrent failures: idp binding mismatch and audit-shipper interruption. Fix plan: temporary tolerance for artifact binding in auth-proxy, backfill missing audit events, and requeue deprovs for affected tenants.

kevin-m: Proposed auth-proxy hotfix (small config flag): enable_artifact_fallback=true — proxy will accept Artifact and convert to POST flow for verification. We can gate by tenant to minimize blast radius. I'll open PR.

raj-p: I'll take KMS/token-store sanity check — confirm whether any wrapped keys remain referencing old alias. If so, we'll unwrap/rewrap tokens and rotate consumers.

oncall: I'll open an incident ticket and run the mitigation steps listed below. Running requeue+backfill now (attach logs once done).

oncall: Mitigation commands I'm running:
```
./scripts/requeue-deprov.sh --tenant acme --since 1694448000
./scripts/backfill-audit.sh --start 1694448000 --end 1694452000 --verify
kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-proxy -n infra
```

sso-bot: Deploy 2023.9.11-rotfix (auth-proxy) queued; will auto-promote to canary after health checks :white_check_mark:.

clare-h: Ownership: I will own the backfill & requeue (scripts + verification). Raj owns KMS/token-store investigation. Kevin own auth-proxy patch + canary. David, please produce a short runbook item about audit-shipper hardening to avoid losing events during rotation. Oncall to coordinate incident timeline and customer notifications. Ping here with results, and we'll schedule a postmortem after stabilization. :thumbsup:
